magic_constant_policy: FORBID hard-coded 30 in release logic; derive from package set and control set
rules: exactly one wheel and one sdist per first-party publishable package unless a package-specific platform matrix is explicitly introduced
every release asset is represented in payload-manifest.json and SHA256SUMS
payload-manifest.json binds source commit, source tree, release identity, package-set digest, workflow run ID/attempt, and every member asset digest
candidate container identity (Actions artifact ID and artifact SHA-256 digest) is recorded only after upload in a separate preflight-receipt.json; it MUST NOT be embedded into the artifact it hashes
preflight receipt binds candidate artifact ID/digest to payload-manifest SHA-256 plus source/release/run identities
release-lock binds package identities, normalized project names, versions, wheel hashes, sdist semantic-content hashes and dependency graph
SBOM coverage must include all publishable first-party projects and exact versions
release publisher must reject missing, unexpected, mismatched, or digest-unknown assets
conformance-bundle.zip binds the exact tests/, tools/ and conformance/ source snapshot used by the candidate
